pages.caption: A father runs to welcome his younger son home.
A father has two sons. The younger asks for his share, and the father divides what he owns.
The younger son goes far away and wastes all his money.
Food becomes hard to find. The hungry son finds work feeding pigs.
The son decides to go home and tell his father that he has done wrong.
His father sees him coming while he is still far away.
The father runs to his son, hugs him, and kisses him.
The son admits he has sinned. His father asks for the best robe, a ring, and shoes.
The father welcomes his son with a special meal, and the celebration begins.
The older brother returns from the field and hears that his brother is home.
The older brother is angry and stays outside. His father comes out to invite him in.
The older son complains, and the father reminds him that everything he has is his.
The father says they should celebrate his brother's return. Jesus' story does not say whether the older brother goes inside.
